passage.title: Model paragraph written for TGA
paras: Both Tennyson and Owen present soldiers destroyed by forces they cannot control. [Point] Tennyson's men ride on because 'Theirs not to reason why', [Evidence] a repeated, commanding line [Method] that makes obedience heroic, whereas Owen's refrain 'But nothing happens' [Evidence] makes waiting itself the killer. [Analysis] Perhaps Tennyson is quietly critical too, with his 'blunder'. [Alternative] Writing as Poet Laureate in 1854, and as a soldier in 1917, [Context] they show how the cost of war came to be seen as futility rather than glory. [Significance]
